grammar.topic: Week 9 review: relative clauses, gerund/infinitive, purpose, indirect questions
explainTr: Bu hafta dört şey öğrendin: who / which / that / where / whose ile tanımlama; enjoy -ing ve decide to gibi fiil kalıpları; to / in order to / so that ile amaç; Could you tell me...? ile kibar sorular. Bugün hepsini mülakat sorularında bir arada kullanıyorsun.
Hızlı hatırlatma: kişi = who, yer = where, sahiplik = whose + isim. Edattan sonra -ing, decide / hope / plan'dan sonra to + fiil. Dolaylı soruda do/does yok ve düz cümle sırası var.
Mülakatta kısa, net ve kibar cümleler iyidir. Mükemmel İngilizce gerekmez; doğru kalıp ve sakin ses yeterlidir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede mülakat cümleleri çoğu zaman uzun bir sıfat-fiil ya da ek zinciriyle kurulur. İngilizcede aynı fikri kısa cümlelere bölüp who / where / so that gibi bağlaçlarla bağlarsın.

reading.title: Practice interview at home
reading.text:
On Sunday evening, Hafsa has a practice interview with Emre. He sits at the table with a notebook and acts like a serious principal. "Hafsa, please tell me about yourself," he says in a deep voice. She laughs, but then she answers: "I am a mother who moved from Isparta to the United States three years ago. I enjoy working with children, and I am studying to become a substitute teacher."

"What is your biggest strength?" Emre asks. "I am patient, and I never give up. When a child can't read a word, I try a different way so that he can understand." "And your weakness?" Hafsa thinks for a moment. "My English is not perfect yet, but I practice every day in order to improve it." Emre nods. "That is an honest answer. Now give me an example of a difficult situation."

Hafsa remembers a day when a boy cried because he lost his lunch card. "I sat with him, I asked what happened, and I took him to the office where Mr. Brown helped us. He stopped crying and finished his lesson."

After thirty minutes, Emre closes the notebook. "Mom, you sound confident. They will hire you." Hafsa is not so sure, but she feels more ready. Before she goes to bed, she puts her resume and two references in a folder, and she prints the directions to the school. Tomorrow is a big day.

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa. Please sit down. Could you tell me a little about yourself?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Of course. I'm from Isparta, and I've lived here for three years. I enjoy working with children, and I'm taking a course to get my certificate.

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: Why do you want to be a substitute teacher?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I want to help children learn. Also, I need a flexible job so that I can take care of my home.

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: What do you do when a student refuses to follow the rules?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I stay calm and speak quietly. I ask him why he is upset, and then we find a solution.

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: That is a good answer. Do you have any questions for me?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. Could you tell me how many classes a substitute teaches each day?

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: Usually three or four. You will get the lesson plans at the office in the morning.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: And do you know when I will hear from you?

script.speaker: Ms. Hall
script.text: We will call you by Friday. Thank you for coming.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you for your time, Ms. Hall.

writing.promptTr: Mülakat için kısa bir tanıtım yaz: kimsin, güçlü ve zayıf yönün, neden bu işi istiyorsun, ve bir kibar soru. Haftanın dilbilgisini kullan (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a short self-introduction for a job interview. Include your strength, your weakness, why you want the job, and one polite question. (80-120 words)
frames: I want this job so that I can ...
writing.model: My name is Hafsa. I am a mother from Isparta, and I have lived in the United States for three years. I enjoy working with children who need extra help. My biggest strength is that I am patient. My weakness is that my English is not perfect, so I practice every day in order to improve it. I want to be a substitute teacher so that I can support students and learn from other teachers. Could you tell me how many classes a substitute teaches each day? I was also wondering when I will hear from you. Thank you for your time.
checklistTr: En az bir who/where/whose cümleciği var mı?
Enjoy -ing ve decide/want to + fiil kalıplarını doğru kullandın mı?
Amaç için to, in order to ya da so that var mı?
Dolaylı sorularda düz cümle sırası kullandın mı?
